_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest for issue #1822 / #1872 paired proof. Read by apps/front/scripts/ci/run-proofs.ts BEFORE classification. Each test declared in `expectedRed` MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code. If a declared kept-red test PASSES, the runner fails CI with verdict CORRUPT PROOF.

expectedRed.testName: server.ts still imports the pre-#1628 `serveStatic` from srvx/static (#1822/#1872)
expectedRed.why: On correct code server.ts imports `staticMiddleware` (not `serveStatic`), so the regex does not match and `expect(importsServeStatic).toBe(true)` fails with an AssertionError — the kept-red state. If this test PASSES, server.ts has been reverted to the pre-#1628 import shape (or aliased to it), which makes the front crash at startup under srvx 0.12.7 and re-opens the publish-now e2e regression.

expectedRed.testName: apps/front/server.ts calls `serveStatic` from srvx/static (#1822/#1872 — call-site contract)
expectedRed.why: On correct code server.ts carries no `serveStatic` call site at all (`createStaticMiddleware(...)` is what calls the live export), so the word-boundary regex does not match and `expect(callsServeStatic).toBe(true)` fails with an AssertionError — the kept-red state. If this test PASSES, a `serveStatic({...})` call has re-entered server.ts (with or without the import line), which is the runtime half of the bug and re-opens the publish-now e2e regression at server startup.
